notes: LDXR: LOAD ROUNDED (extended to long HFP), RR 0x25. R2=4 is a valid FP pair designator (PoP 9-8).
MXR: MULTIPLY (extended HFP), RR 0x26. R1=4/R2=8 valid pairs.
LEDR: LOAD ROUNDED (long to short HFP), RR 0x35.
AXR: ADD NORMALIZED (extended HFP), RR 0x36. R1=1/R2=5 valid pairs.
SXR: SUBTRACT NORMALIZED (extended HFP), RR 0x37. R1=0/R2=4 valid pairs.
MXD: MULTIPLY (long to extended HFP), RX-a 0x67. R1=1 valid pair, EA=0x123(r2).
LPXR: LOAD POSITIVE (extended HFP), RRE B360.
LNXR: LOAD NEGATIVE (extended HFP), RRE B361.
LTXR: LOAD AND TEST (extended HFP), RRE B362.
LCXR: LOAD COMPLEMENT (extended HFP), RRE B363.
LXR: LOAD (extended), RRE B365.
LEXR: LOAD ROUNDED (extended to short HFP), RRE B366.
FIXR: LOAD FP INTEGER (extended HFP), RRE B367.
CXR: COMPARE (extended HFP), RRE B369.
MAER: MULTIPLY AND ADD (short HFP), RRD B32E. byte3=R1, byte4=R3R2.
MSER: MULTIPLY AND SUBTRACT (short HFP), RRD B32F.
MADR: MULTIPLY AND ADD (long HFP), RRD B33E.
MSDR: MULTIPLY AND SUBTRACT (long HFP), RRD B33F.
MAYLR: MULTIPLY AND ADD UNNORMALIZED (long to ext. low HFP), RRD B338.
MYLR: MULTIPLY UNNORMALIZED (long to ext. low HFP), RRD B339.
MAYR: MULTIPLY AND ADD UNNORMALIZED (long to ext. HFP), RRD B33A.
MYR: MULTIPLY UNNORMALIZED (long to ext. HFP), RRD B33B.
MAYHR: MULTIPLY AND ADD UNNORMALIZED (long to ext. high HFP), RRD B33C.
MYHR: MULTIPLY UNNORMALIZED (long to ext. high HFP), RRD B33D.
MAE: MULTIPLY AND ADD (short HFP), RXF ED2E. byte5=R1, IGN nibble 0.
MSE: MULTIPLY AND SUBTRACT (short HFP), RXF ED2F.
MAD: MULTIPLY AND ADD (long HFP), RXF ED3E.
MSD: MULTIPLY AND SUBTRACT (long HFP), RXF ED3F.
LDXR alternate pair (12,14): R1=0, R2=12.
MXR alternate odd pair: R1=13, R2=9.
